$comment: Hand-written corrections applied on top of the routes parsed from docs/plan/PLAN.md §12.3 by gen-ownership.ts. Every entry states why the prose of the plan needs a structured correction. Owned by WP-00 (and WP-90/WP-93 during hardening).

WP-00.reason: The plan lists the skeleton files in prose ('esqueletos (package.json, tsconfig.json y src/index.ts) de apps/{...} y packages/{...}'); expand them into exact paths.

WP-20.reason: 'apps/api/** salvo src/modules/*/ de dominio' means: every module except the domain modules owned by other WPs (platform modules such as health or stream stay with WP-20). Same for worker jobs. apps/api/test/legacy belongs to WP-32. The WP-00 skeleton files of packages/core and packages/emails that no other route covers (tsconfig.json, emails src/index.ts) pass to WP-20, which implements those packages' platform.

WP-22.reason: The WP-00 skeleton entry apps/web/src/index.ts is not covered by WP-22's routes; it passes to WP-22, which turns apps/web into the Astro project (it may delete or repurpose it).

WP-34.reason: 'apps/web/src/console/** (raíz, router, lib, layout, guard y hooks)': the console platform, not the routes/features owned by the area WPs. The bare word `lib` in the prose is not a path.

WP-80.reason: '(salvo new, drafts y new-version)' refers to the WP-74 routes, one of which is basecamp/mods/$modId/new-version.tsx; derive the exclusions from WP-74's patterns instead of the prose.

WP-91.reason: WP-91 (e2e/**) and WP-93 (e2e/security/**) run in the same wave W9; PLAN §12.1 requires disjoint paths within a wave, so the security suite stays with WP-93.
